name: CATARC Automotive Proving Ground Co.,Ltd.
summary: CATARC Automotive Proving Ground Co.,Ltd., a technical service company, provides track testing technical services to automotive manufacturers, automotive testing institutions, automotive parts system companies, and tire companies in China. The company also provides driving training services; and new car launch and media event services. It also engages in investment, construction, operation, and management of automotive proving grounds; and operates hotels. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Yancheng, China.
